title: Finite-coefficient inputs detect natural compact-support comparisons
statement: Let l,E,k,X,Y,f,c and the two compact-support functors be as in [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] and [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action]. Suppose two natural transformations between the actual completed proper/open functor restricted to integral constructible inputs and the recorded integral compact-support functor followed by ambient inclusion agree at every constructible integral input which is isomorphic to the restriction of a derived complex over one positive finite quotient of the completed coefficient ring [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Then the natural transformations agree. No finite scalar-reduction equality is assumed in this statement.
